field_evidence.service_scope: GOV.UK states that the public Find an energy certificate service can find existing EPC, DEC and air-conditioning inspection certificates for properties in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
field_evidence.search_inputs: The official service states that users can search by postcode, street name and town, or certificate number.
field_evidence.target_query_intent: Forge Cottage, Ruckinge Road, TN25 7JX; domestic-property search intended as this single target window.
field_evidence.transport_result: The current transport can open the official public/no-login service entry and domestic/non-domestic selection page, but cannot submit the interactive form to retrieve a target-specific Forge Cottage certificate result.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: An EPC is a building energy-assessment record; this service window does not supply a registered-title/index-polygon geometry, cadastral/title polygon, canonical parcel bbox or title number.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted from the address-search workflow or any inferred EPC/property identity.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. GOV.UK’s official public/no-login Find an energy certificate service can search a property by postcode, street name and town, but the interactive target search for Forge Cottage, Ruckinge Road, TN25 7JX cannot be submitted through this transport, and an EPC record would identify a building energy assessment rather than a registered-title/index-polygon geometry or canonical parcel bbox. Local OpenCode or another authoritative target-specific workflow must bind the exact registered-title/title-boundary polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from HM Land Registry Price Paid Linked Data SPARQL target querying to the GOV.UK Find an energy certificate public property-search workflow. The official service is public/no-login and supports postcode/street/town searches, but this transport cannot submit the interactive target form and no Forge Cottage certificate result is returned here. Even a retrieved EPC is building-level energy-assessment evidence, not canonical cadastral/title geometry. No title polygon, parcel bbox or parcel ID is inferred; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
